versions.content: AUTOSAR shall provide concurrent access to cryptographic services Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR shall provide concurrent access to all the requesting applications. In case of shared resource, a service might not be available to an application. This shall be resolved by priority handling for the access of different applications of the crypto (HW or SW) in parallel. Rationale: Different applications shall request crypto services simultaneously. Example: safety applications shall get prior access than non-safety applications. Enabling reentrancy allows parallel utilization of crypto services Use Case: Prioritization (0002), Handling of multi task calls (0005) Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: --
